scientific_question: Is the strongest remaining EXTRACT residual primarily a destructive selection/global-budget collision between complementary teacher-blind evidence-intent branches, rather than a need for another semantic-similarity certificate or a new ranker/model family?

established: Coarse page routing is not the dominant residual on the preserved teacher control: the exact selected-page proposition pool contains substantially stronger evidence than the currently selected propositions.

Under frozen answer-free atom-specific evidence intents, the existing ranking stack is sufficient on the preserved teacher control: BM25 supports 11/13 atoms at top-12 and BGE-M3 dense/ColBERT/hybrid plus Qwen3-Reranker support 13/13.
Automatic source-aware BM25 intent generation provides the strongest stable control at 7/13 supported atoms.
Automatic author-anchored BM25 obligations recover complementary residual atoms e1.a and e6.a but displace four control-supported atoms, ending at 5/13.
DYNAMIC_SAME_PAGE_ALIGNMENT_SWAP_V1 preserves all 7/7 control-supported atoms and safely recovers e6.a, reaching ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE at 8/13.

Learned NLI thresholding, dependency predicate/argument units, and AMR graph+Smatch all failed their frozen external redundancy-certificate gates and are negative evidence against reopening the generic pairwise-score -> threshold -> safe-redundancy premise without genuinely new evidence.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The source-aware and author-anchored branches already retrieve complementary useful evidence, but forcing them into a fixed 24-item globally competitive set or replacement mechanism causes useful residual evidence to displace established control coverage.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: A small non-destructive append-only frontier from the frozen author-anchored ordering adds e1.a/e6.a while the immutable source-aware top-24 retains all seven frozen control atoms.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The automatically generated branches remain too incomplete or poorly ordered; the missing residual evidence is not present early enough in a small additive frontier.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Even an append-only frontier through the predeclared diagnostic ceiling fails to recover both observed residual atoms.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Some remaining unsupported atoms require multiple propositions/evidence pieces jointly rather than a better single-proposition selection.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Single-proposition additive coverage remains weak despite evidence availability; prior bundle diagnostics were only modestly positive, so this remains secondary until H1 is tested.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Some selected propositions may semantically support target atoms while the existing frozen support evaluator fails to recognize them.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Future independent semantic/annotation audit finds support not reflected by the frozen teacher-support metric; this diagnostic does not alter that metric.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The necessary proposition is outside the frozen automatic candidate order despite page-level exposure.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: The residual remains absent through the additive frontier even though oracle answer-free intents can retrieve it.

preserved_positive_evidence.role: Alignment remains a validated sparse preservation guard/reference. This design does not discard it; it tests whether destructive replacement is necessary at all before attempting another compression/certificate mechanism.

architecture_family_comparison.rationale: Directly tests branch complementarity and budget collision using only already-frozen teacher-blind branches. It requires no new generation, no new model, no semantic pairwise threshold, and preserves the validated source-aware core by construction.

External work shows decomposed subquestions can improve complementary evidence retrieval, but prior EXTRACT evidence already identifies automatic intent generation as a bottleneck; generating a new decomposition policy before testing the existing complementary branches would confound the smallest falsifiable premise.

FIRE, DIVER, and multi-hop evidence-pursuit systems support iterative search when fixed retrieval is incomplete, but this is materially more complex and requires an independently valid gap/stopping signal.

Minimal-evidence-group work supports set-level reasoning, but the published formulation relies on entailment estimates. The frozen EXTRACT NLI certificate failed, so importing an entailment-based set-cover judge now would reopen a rejected premise without new evidence.
Technologically distinct NLI and AMR implementations both failed the broader pairwise-score/threshold safe-redundancy premise; repetition or cosmetic model/threshold changes are not new evidence.
The answer-free intent oracle already demonstrates sufficient ranker capacity on the preserved teacher control; model-family change is not the smallest explanation for current failure.

external_research_evidence.source: Ammann, Golde, Akbik. Question Decomposition for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. ACL SRW 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Decompose into subquestions, retrieve per subquestion, then merge/rerank the candidate pool; reported gains support complementary-query coverage as a distinct mechanism from pairwise redundancy scoring.

external_research_evidence.source: Chen et al. Complex Claim Verification with Evidence Retrieved in the Wild. NAACL 2024.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Complex verification benefits from explicit decomposition plus fine-grained evidence retrieval and aggregation, supporting separation of coverage acquisition from final judgment.

external_research_evidence.source: Xie et al. Do RAG Systems Cover What Matters? NAACL 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Sub-question coverage exposes missing facets that aggregate relevance can hide; coverage planning is therefore a plausible mechanism family distinct from semantic redundancy scoring.

external_research_evidence.source: Xie et al. FIRE: Fact-checking with Iterative Retrieval and Verification. Findings NAACL 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Iterative retrieval can use current verification state to decide whether more evidence is needed; this supports a later gap-directed family if a static frozen frontier proves insufficient.

external_research_evidence.source: Zhang, Kabir, Boyd-Graber. DIVER. Findings EMNLP 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Incremental claim extraction and evidence refinement provide recent evidence for iterative coverage/stopping architectures rather than single-shot similarity thresholds.

external_research_evidence.source: Li et al. Minimal Evidence Group Identification for Claim Verification. TrustNLP 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Some claims require evidence groups rather than single evidence pieces; useful for the compositional hypothesis, but its entailment dependency prevents direct adoption after EXTRACT's NLI rejection.

external_research_evidence.source: Hu, Long, Wang. Decomposition Dilemmas. NAACL 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Decomposition can introduce noise and is not universally beneficial, so EXTRACT should first test the smallest existing-branch coverage premise rather than assume a new decomposition policy will help.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Determine whether a small append-only union of already-generated complementary evidence-intent branches can recover the two observed residual atoms without sacrificing the validated source-aware core.
inputs: Frozen QWEN35_SOURCE_AWARE_INTENTS_V1 BM25_DIRECT ordering from valid Wave 7A.3/control lineage.
Frozen QWEN35_AUTHOR_ANCHORED_OBLIGATIONS_V1 BM25_DIRECT ordering from valid Wave 7A.3 run 40027366528 / artifact 12533721500.
Same nine-paper authoritative PDF/proposition substrate and frozen teacher-support evaluator.
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE result as a preservation reference/control only; no alignment score participates in candidate selection.

selector.immutable_core: Exact frozen source-aware BM25 RRF top-24 propositions per paper.
selector.append_stream: Exact frozen author-anchored BM25 RRF order with propositions already present in the immutable core removed; preserve original order.
selector.operation: Append only. Never delete, replace, rerank, or alter the 24-item source-aware core.

frozen_controls: FROZEN_AUTHOR_ANCHORED_BM25_RRF_V1 top-24: 5/13, including residual e1.a and e6.a but only 3/7 frozen controls.
DYNAMIC_SAME_PAGE_ALIGNMENT_SWAP_V1: ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE, 8/13, all 7/7 controls retained, e6.a recovered.
CONTROL20_RESIDUAL4_QUOTA_V1 remains diagnostic-only/non-promotable and is not used to select or calibrate this append-only mechanism.

ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_CONFIRMED: At budget <=28, all 7/7 frozen source-aware control-supported atoms remain supported.
Both observed complementary residual atoms e1.a and e6.a are supported.
ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_PARTIAL: CONFIRMED is not met, but by budget <=28 at least one of e1.a/e6.a is recovered with all 7/7 controls retained; OR both are recovered only at budget 32.
Interpretation: budget collision contributes but does not fully explain the residual at the preferred small frontier.
ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_NEGATIVE: Neither CONFIRMED nor PARTIAL is met by the frozen maximum diagnostic ceiling of 32, or a provenance/teacher-blind boundary fails.
Interpretation: reject small static append-only branch union as the primary remaining mechanism.

decision_table.ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_CONFIRMED: Authorize design of a bounded non-destructive multi-intent evidence-set architecture. The next design must address cost/compression explicitly and should retain ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE as a possible compression guard/reference; no production promotion is authorized.
decision_table.ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_PARTIAL: Do not tune the frontier budget. Conclude that static budget collision is only a contributor; next architecture search should compare source-derived subquestion decomposition against iterative gap-directed retrieval.
decision_table.ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_NEGATIVE: Reject static append-only branch union. Move directly to a materially different query/decomposition or iterative gap-pursuit mechanism; do not reopen NLI/predicate-argument/AMR redundancy certificates.
decision_table.OPERATIONAL_FAILURE_BEFORE_SCIENCE: No scientific verdict. Repair only the operational defect if science is unchanged, then require explicit one-shot recovery authority.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one scientific execution after independent design review. Stop immediately at the frozen verdict. No budget edits, branch-order edits, teacher-informed candidate changes, threshold/model/parser/prompt changes, or second scientific run after a valid result.
selected_discriminating_experiment.pass_authority: A CONFIRMED result authorizes only the next bounded architecture/design phase for non-destructive multi-intent evidence-set retrieval and cost/compression study. It does not authorize production EXTRACT changes, Wave 7B, semantic-control output, or removal of Codex fallback/VERIFY.

reviewer_boundary: Independent reviewer must audit this frozen design before implementation. Routine implementation/CI/packaging/routing/trigger mechanics do not require reviewer stops unless they materially change the frozen experiment. After the genuine result, reviewer must be consulted again before next scientific phase selection.
next_safe_action: Run normal CI on this design-only artifact and merge only if clean. Then persist the design checkpoint in workspace-control and obtain an independent-review checkpoint for this exact design SHA. Do not implement NONDESTRUCTIVE_EVIDENCE_FRONTIER_DIAGNOSTIC_V1 before that review is durable.
